title: I Built an AI Agent That Works While I Sleep (Cheap & Easy)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

stated_problem.quote: who feels overwhelmed to social media
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: AI automation agent service
idea.one_liner: Build and maintain custom AI agent workflows for businesses and creators, using a YouTube-to-LinkedIn content generator as an example, for setup fees and recurring fees.
idea.customer: Creators and business owners, including businesses in real estate, fitness, restaurants, and health care.
idea.offer: Custom AI workflows that connect apps and services. The demonstrated example gets a YouTube transcript, extracts insights, and generates short, medium, and long LinkedIn posts.
idea.revenue_model: One-time setup fees plus monthly per-client and ongoing maintenance fees.

key_quotes.quote: This is fully working and functional and ready for you to use for yourself or to sell to others.
You could charge between $300 and $800 a month per client.
Then start asking if they will pay you to build more agents for them to solve more problems for them.
Deploy end-to-end, build this content multiplier agent, then find any creator, any business owner who feels overwhelmed to social media, implement this into their process.

claims.claim: n8n cloud hosting starts at $20 per month.
claims.quote: n8n offers cloud hosting that starts at 20 bucks a month

claims.claim: With several automations or one very active automation, n8n cloud costs can rise past $100 per month.
claims.quote: once you have half a dozen automations running, or even one automation that's just very active, those costs can quickly balloon way past $100 a month.

claims.claim: Self-hosted n8n is free and open source.
claims.quote: n8n itself, not n8n cloud, is free and it's open source

claims.claim: Self-hosting has the same price for 10 or 100 agents with unlimited usage.
claims.quote: That way it's the same price for 10 agents or 100 agents with unlimited usage.

claims.claim: The service could charge $300 to $800 per client per month.
claims.quote: You could charge between $300 and $800 a month per client.

claims.claim: Ten clients could bring in about $5,000 per month, described as almost pure profit.
claims.quote: 10 clients equals, call it $5,000 a month, and that's almost pure profit.

claims.claim: A one-time $2,000 setup fee could lead to $20,000 in monthly revenue.
claims.quote: You could charge $2,000 one time for a setup fee, and before you know it, you're at $20,000 a month in revenue.

claims.claim: There are thousands of templates and automations that could be built for customers.
claims.quote: And this is one of thousands of templates, thousands of automations that you could build for people.

claims.claim: AI tools could let the provider charge less for comparable or better service.
claims.quote: So you were able to charge less for as good if not better service.

claims.claim: The first client could serve as a case study that helps win three more clients.
claims.quote: Your first client is your case study and helps you get your next three clients.

claims.claim: At five or 10 clients, the provider could hire a virtual assistant.
claims.quote: After five or 10 clients, you can hire a virtual assistant to help you out.

claims.claim: After six to 12 months, the provider could reach 10 to 30 clients and $10,000 to $30,000 per month.
claims.quote: After six to 12 months, you scale to 10 to 30 clients, and you're making 10 to $30,000 a month.

claims.claim: The projected monthly income includes setup and ongoing maintenance fees.
claims.quote: That includes the setup fees and the ongoing maintenance fees.

claims.claim: The setup could take less time than watching the video.
claims.quote: You could set this up for less time than it took to watch this video.

acquisition_channels.details: Build for friends for free, ask whether they will pay for more agents, and use the first client as a case study to attract three more.

ideas.delivery: The provider builds and maintains custom workflows in n8n, connecting services such as YouTube, a transcript API, OpenAI, and LinkedIn. The demo runs on a schedule and generates several LinkedIn post formats from a video transcript.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR is relevant if workflows process identifiable lead, inbox, or customer data; use suitable processor terms and security. DMCC Act consumer subscription rules would need checking if the service were sold to consumers on a subscription basis.
